storms.name: Helene
storms.note: Helene: Cat 4 Big Bend landfall; extreme inland flooding in western NC knocked out Baxter North Cove, ~60% of US IV fluids.

storms.name: Milton
storms.note: Milton: rapid intensification to Cat 5 then Florida landfall near Sarasota; tornadoes and mass evacuation strained Gulf-coast hospital supply.

storms.name: Ian
storms.note: Ian: Cat 4 landfall in SW Florida with record surge; hospital evacuations and distribution disruption.

storms.name: Ida
storms.note: Ida: Cat 4 Louisiana landfall on the Ida anniversary of Katrina; long power outages and Gulf-coast plant/distribution disruption.

storms.name: Michael
storms.note: Michael: explosive rapid intensification to Cat 5 before Florida Panhandle landfall; tests short-lead warning limits.

storms.name: Florence
storms.note: Florence: slow-moving Carolinas rain event with record river flooding near NC plants (Pfizer Rocky Mount, Baxter Marion region).

storms.name: Maria
storms.note: Maria: Cat 4 direct hit on Puerto Rico; island-wide outage crippled PR sterile-injectable plants and caused the 2017-18 IV bag shortage.

storms.name: Harvey
storms.note: Harvey: stalled over Texas with 60+ in of rain; extreme rainfall flooding of Houston-area facilities and distribution.

storms.name: Irma
storms.note: Irma: Cat 5 track up Florida and the Caribbean; long-track wind and outage hazard to PR and Florida supply chain.

storms.name: Katrina
storms.note: Katrina: Cat 3 Gulf landfall with catastrophic surge; benchmark for hospital and pharmacy supply collapse.

storms.name: Hugo
storms.note: Hugo: Cat 4 Charleston landfall that carried hurricane winds well inland to Charlotte, NC; wind decay inland benchmark.

storms.name: Andrew
storms.note: Andrew: compact Cat 5 Florida landfall; benchmark for small-radius intense wind field and rapid inland decay.
